Classify the Validation Folds of the Molecular Diagnostic Branch

Source: R/barcoding_classifier.R
classify_barcoding_folds.Rd

Step 7 of the branch. Reads the library of step 4 and the folds of step 5, classifies every query of every fold and writes the raw predictions, one row per query. It aggregates nothing: no accuracy, no rate, no mean. The negative controls (step 8) and the metrics (step 10) read these tables afterwards.

Usage

classify_barcoding_folds(
  library_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "4_library"),
  folds_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "5_folds"),
  output_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "7_classifier"),
  method = c("nn", "idtaxa"),
  model = "raw",
  min_comparable = 100L,
  schemes = c("species", "genus"),
  loci = NULL,
  max_folds = NULL,
  seed = 1L,
  threshold = 60,
  chunk = NULL,
  n_chunks = NULL,
  alignment = c("library", "add"),
  mafft_exec = "mafft",
  mafft_opts = "--auto",
  workers = 1L,
  notify = FALSE,
  notify_to = NULL,
  notify_credentials = NULL
)

Arguments

library_dir

Character. Output directory of finalize_barcoding_library().

folds_dir

Character. Output directory of build_barcoding_folds().

output_dir

Character. Destination; refused inside a directory of the phylogeny.

method

Character. "nn", the branch classifier, or "idtaxa", the contrast.

model

Character. Distance model of ape::dist.dna(), for "nn".

min_comparable

Integer. Minimum number of comparable positions for a pair to have a value Pairs below it are left without value, never imputed.

schemes

Character vector. "species" (scheme E) and "genus" (scheme G).

loci

Character vector or NULL for every locus of the library.

max_folds

Integer or NULL. Folds per locus and scheme; a declared random subset, for the contrast with IdTaxa, which retrains once per fold. NULL means all of them.

seed

Integer. Seed of that subset, so it is reproducible, and, for "idtaxa", the seed from which the seed of every query is derived with its locus, scheme, fold and sid, so that each answer is reproducible and independent of the rest of the run.

threshold

Numeric. Confidence threshold applied to the output of DECIPHER::IdTaxa(), for "idtaxa". IdTaxa itself always runs at threshold 0 and the confidence of each rank is written (genus_confidence, species_confidence), so any other threshold can be applied afterwards with the same result as a run at that threshold.

chunk, n_chunks

Integers, or NULL for a run without chunks. With both, only chunk chunk of n_chunks is classified: inside each locus and scheme the folds, in the order of step 5, are dealt round-robin to the chunks. The chunk writes its tables in chunks/ of output_dir, with the suffix _chunk<k>of<n>, together with its session; the tables of a whole run are then written by merge_barcoding_chunks(). For a job array on a cluster, see generate_barcoding_job_scripts().

alignment

Character. How the distance of a query is measured, for "nn". "library", the default, reads it from the joint alignment of the library, in which the query took part. "add" removes the query's gaps, orients it against the training set of its fold and adds it to that training alignment with MAFFT --add --keeplength, one call per query: the path of the outgroup control and of a query brought by a user. On 2026-09-25 the two paths agreed on 699 of 720 queries and 4 answers changed. "add" writes its own tables, with the suffix _add, and never touches those of "library".

mafft_exec, mafft_opts

Command of the MAFFT binary and its options, for alignment = "add".

workers

Integer. 1, the default, runs in this R session. More than 1 splits the folds into that many chunks (as chunk and n_chunks do) and runs them as parallel R processes of this machine, each writing its log in chunks/ of output_dir; the progress is written to PROGRESS_<method>.txt of output_dir every minute and printed; when every worker has finished the chunks are merged with merge_barcoding_chunks(), into the same tables as a run of one process, and notify sends one email. A worker that fails stops the others and the run. On macOS the machine is kept awake with caffeinate while the run lasts. The workers load the installed package. Cannot be combined with chunk.

notify

Logical. Send an email when the run ends, whether it finished or failed. Intended for method = "idtaxa", which retrains once per fold and is measured in hours. A notification that cannot be sent is reported and ignored: it never fails the run. See send_run_notification() for what has to be configured. Defaults to FALSE.

notify_to, notify_credentials

Passed to send_run_notification() as to and credentials. Both default to NULL, which reads the MY_EMAIL and PHYLOCACTUS_SMTP_CREDS environment variables.

Value

Invisibly, a list of prediction tables by scheme. Writes TABLE_barcoding_predictions_<scheme>_<method>.csv and TABLE_barcoding_timing_<method>.csv, one row per locus and scheme with the folds, the queries and the seconds they took; with alignment = "add" both names carry the suffix _add and the prediction tables add the columns alignment and orientation.

Details

The output has three states: species, genus with the specific ambiguity declared, and not assignable. The state comes from the structure of the tie at the minimum distance, not from a threshold, so the threshold can be swept later over nn_distance, margin and confidence without classifying again.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
classify_barcoding_folds(
  library_dir = "11_barcoding/4_library",
  folds_dir = "11_barcoding/5_folds",
  output_dir = "11_barcoding/7_classifier"
)
} # }
